description: Filter the US ISO interconnection queue server-side by size, wait time, ISO, fuel, status, fiber distance and geocoding, and return only matching projects.

baseload_only.description: Keep only firm/dispatchable fuel (nuclear, gas, steam, geothermal, hydro, coal); exclude wind/solar/storage. Firm-vs-intermittent split only — does NOT sub-divide peaker vs combined-cycle gas (no duty-cycle field in the queue). Default false

developer.description: ERCOT only: keep projects whose developer name contains this text (case-insensitive substring, e.g. 'tenaska'). Developer names come from ERCOTQueue (ercotqueue.com, Matt Prusak, CC BY 4.0) joined to ERCOT's own queue by INR; other ISOs carry no developer field, so they return no rows when this is set. Answers that use it carry an attribution block

fuel_type.description: Isolate a fuel by inclusive substring match on the raw label; comma/semicolon-separated for a union, e.g. 'gas' hits GAS/Natural Gas, 'nuclear,hydro' unions both. Runs the fuel filter server-side instead of post-filtering survivors in context

geocoded_only.description: Keep only survivors that carry lat/lng (~83% of the queue) — the ones with a ready site_evaluation_handoff you can pipe into analyze_site. Default false

iso.description: Restrict to one or more ISOs, comma-separated for a union: PJM, ERCOT, MISO, CAISO, SPP, NYISO, ISONE (ISO-NE). e.g. iso=ERCOT,PJM. Omit for all; combines with max_ttp_months as an intersection

limit.description: Max results to return (1-500; default varies by tool)

max_fiber_km.description: Keep only survivors within N km of the nearest MAPPED long-haul fiber route endpoint — coarse backbone proximity from a sparse ~260-node dataset over a county-centroid origin, NOT last-mile fiber. Implies geocoded rows only

max_ttp_months.description: Max time-to-power in months (ISO-level avg interconnection wait; HARD cut keeping projects in ISOs at/under this — PJM ~51, CAISO ~40, ISO-NE ~34, MISO ~34, ERCOT ~33, NYISO ~31, SPP ~24; <=30 leaves only SPP)

min_mw.description: Minimum project capacity in MW, e.g. 1000 for 1 GW+

status.description: Queue status filter. Default 'active' = still progressing (excludes withdrawn/cancelled/suspended/in-commercial-operation) — cross-ISO safe (SPP labels live projects 'IA FULLY EXECUTED/ON SCHEDULE' not 'active'). Pass 'all' for every status, or a literal label to substring-match
